items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Big Al Louie directly; the interviewer mentions him in relation to Jimbo, and the interviewee responds only about Jimbo.

ctx.x: Oh, Jimbo? Yeah. Oh, we used to whip Jimbo crazy. Jimbo, we whippin' crazy a lot in his class. He used to play C-clin. Played C-clin.
He was a pupil of Big Al Louie, T.O.'s, wasn't he?
I think he was. Oh, I don't know if you call him a pupil. He always admired Big Al Louie, I don't know. He gave Big Al Louie that clap. That's right. Yeah. Right.
